title: B: warm the model at service start, after an update and before scheduled briefs
goal: B: warm the model at service start, after an update and before scheduled briefs
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ollama a+b, c as option in dashboard".

A warm-up helper loads the role models with no prompt text (POST /api/generate with keep_alive) at service start, after a lifecycle update restart, and about 1 minute before a scheduled brief or reminder that needs the model (reminder engine, src/battery-storage-reminders.ts and the update scheduler path name the moments)

Warm-ups are deduplicated, never overlap a live request, are skipped when the model is already resident (/api/ps) or Ollama is unreachable, and a failure never blocks start or a reminder (model outage does not stop reminders); tests across the scheduler and the helper (a join test, not one per side)
privacy: Local Ollama only; test data is neutral and invented; no secrets; warm-up calls carry no user text.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the existing engine-provider, config and dashboard code; bounded edit plus tests. Not a measurement.
